WITH RECURSIVE tag_split(rest, tag) AS (SELECT p.Tags, NULL FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.CommentCount = 0 AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL AND p.Tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1), substr(rest, 2, instr(rest, '>') - 2) FROM tag_split WHERE rest <> '') SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM tag_split WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> '' ORDER BY tag
